method: Existing Google Cloud Translation draft with agent corrections and independent AI review; no human/native-speaker validation
notes: Independently compared the 194-field catalog with the frozen English marketing source, including navigation, accessibility controls, download instructions and screenshots.

Corrected semantic drift where present: lime colour versus stone/tree, game tutorial versus video/music, installation archive vocabulary, indirect-control role descriptions, creature needs and screenshot details.

Preserved early-access, guest/ranked sign-in and browser-save qualifications; verified every key, placeholder, protected brand, executable command and literal screenshot counter. Native game building terminology was reconciled where available.
AI review only; no human/native-speaker validation or deployment is established by this record.
